digest.component_or_area: Rebar LLM Agent run accounting and Pydantic-AI integration
propositions: Successful multi-attempt Agent runs must report aggregate whole-run usage (sum across all attempts) in memory, telemetry, and exactly one durable JSONL row, never per-attempt or rejected-attempt rows.

Validation-failure exhaustion must re-raise the identical original Rebar StructuredOutputError object by walking the UnexpectedModelBehavior cause chain (UnexpectedModelBehavior → ToolRetryError → ModelRetry → StructuredOutputError).
Repeated-truncation/output-size exhaustion with no Rebar object on the cause chain must construct and raise a fresh UnretryableOutputError as the defined fallback.
Unrelated UnexpectedModelBehavior exceptions (not marked 'Exceeded maximum output retries') must pass through unchanged without translation.
Terminal failure must preserve consumed requests and tokens in diagnostics and write complete final provider response only when artifact capture is enabled, never during retries.
No new competing request-budget fields (candidate_requests, etc.) must appear in _usage or usage JSONL; historical row and pricing compatibility is maintained.
